cues: Thermodynamics studies energy changes in bulk matter, using measurable properties like pressure, volume and temperature.
It says nothing about speed, and nothing about individual molecules.
The system is the part of the universe we are studying.
text: Thermodynamics studies energy changes in bulk matter, using measurable properties like pressure, volume and temperature. It says nothing about speed, and nothing about individual molecules. First, two words. The system is the part of the universe we are studying. The surroundings are everything else.
